label: rem:hopf-diquark-remark
title: Color antitriplet and the sign of Hopf linking
html:
Color representation. The two quarks each carry a color index. Their antisymmetric combination [ab] transforms in the color antitriplet \bar{\mathbf{3}}_c of \mathrm{SU}(3):

  \bar{\mathbf{3}}_c
  = 
  \epsilon^{abc}\mathfrak{q}^b \otimes \mathfrak{q}^c.

The antisymmetry D^{[ab]} = -D^{[ba]} arises from Hopf linking. The linking number is \mathrm{lk}(a, b) = +1 while \mathrm{lk}(b, a) = -1 under component exchange.
